heading: Deliberate and malicious acts, intended to outrage religious feelings of any class by insulting its religion or religious beliefs.
text: Whoever, with deliberate and malicious intention of outraging the religious feelings of any class of [2][citizens of India], [3][by words, either spoken or written, or by signs or by visible representations or otherwise], insults or attempts to insult the religion or the religious beliefs of that class, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to [4][three years], or with fine, or with both.]
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
